# netbox_export_templates (Data Source)

Lists export_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_export_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-export_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `export_templates` (Attributes List) The matching export_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--export_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--export_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `export_templates`

Read-Only:

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download the rendered output as a file instead of displaying it.
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `environment_params` (String) Parameters for the Jinja2 environment as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `file_extension` (String) Extension appended to the file name, e.g. csv.
- `file_name` (String) File name of the rendered output, without extension.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type of the rendered output, e.g. text/csv.
- `name` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the template can export, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `template_code` (String) Jinja2 template code; the queryset is available as {{ queryset }}.
- `url` (String)
